elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added clause applies “Upon the expiration or any termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The added post-expiry/termination commitment is only at least 90 days. The existing six-month continuation applies only to Services requested at least 100 days before scheduled expiration, not transition assistance following any expiry or termination.

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 states that all Expenses and charges for Termination Assistance are computed according to M&I’s then-current rates.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: M&I must “export and deliver to Customer all Customer Data within thirty (30) days” following expiration or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause requires export and delivery but specifies no standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: No deletion or deletion-certification obligation is included.

elements.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
